run_optical_flow: run optical flow estimation on a directory of images using a RAFT model checkpoint
create_raft_model: create a RAFT optical flow model from a checkpoint file and load it onto a device
load_image: load an image file, resize by scale, pad to multiples of 8, and return a tensor
review_main: review the main function that processes image pairs and saves forward and backward flow files
refactor_runflowconfig: refactor the RunFlowConfig dataclass to add new configuration fields for the flow pipeline
